decision.summary: Extract one node-only command-path leaf module and reuse it from server-utils and ssh.ts.
decision.reason: This removes the local sh -c command-v launch, follows Node's unset and empty POSIX PATH behavior, falls back to the current process PATH when a Windows child environment omits PATH, honors case-insensitive Windows environment names and documented PATHEXT fallback, rejects directories, avoids an import cycle, and eliminates the second private resolver.
decision.quoting: ssh.ts imports and re-exports shellQuote from shell-path.ts; remote command construction keeps shellQuote semantics and does not apply local Windows path conversion.
decision.destinationArguments: All six SSH call sites use buildSshDestinationArgs, which places -- before username@host so option-shaped destination data cannot re-enter option parsing.
decision.environmentBoundary: validatedSshEnvEntries is shared by direct commands, spawn targets, and the managed runtime; every non-undefined key must match the portable shell identifier grammar before interpolation.
decision.ratchetBoundary: The exact CLI gate rejects known Node process-launch APIs that run sh/bash/dash/zsh/ksh/ash executable paths plus simple or composite command flags (for example -c, -lc, -ec, or --command) around command-v or which lookup. It covers trusted named-import launcher aliases, aliased shell, argv, lookup strings, template interpolation, and concatenation. Restricting findings to process launchers and trusted import modules avoids labeling passive logging or unrelated same-named imports as execution; unrelated remote shell commands remain allowed.
